scope.reason: This was a discovery pass while independent project workers were active. Byte-heavy measurements were pinned to one physical CPU, but no exclusive sibling or machine-wide reservation was claimed.

prior_exact_main_gate.interpretation: The exact main encoder remained about 2.32 percent faster after the accepted two-tile change.

public_api.interpretation: Batch-one routing and public wrapper setup are indistinguishable at this resolution; the residual is not a batch wrapper problem.

operation_model.note: The structural model reports total public shard bytes; execution tiling preserves that byte work while doubling transform-control traversals.

assembly_and_schedule.exact_main: One 65536-byte pass executes 1244 logical fused radix-four calls in the native field translation unit.
assembly_and_schedule.leopard2: Two 32768-byte passes execute 2488 logical radix-four calls. The selected AVX-512VL range callback uses the split two-way schedule for large tiles and repeatedly expands fixed nibble tables.
eliminated_explanations: ISA mismatch: both paths use 256-bit EVEX vector operations on this host.
Single-thread OpenMP overhead: the earlier isolated diagnostic found only about 0.1 percent.
Generic whole-transform dispatch/table setup: the earlier exact-shape executor was 1.92 percent slower.
Broad fused radix-four payloads: the earlier candidate was 8.36 percent slower.

tile_count.method: Three counter-ordered process rounds on CPU 14; seven retained samples per process, reuse four, exact matching workload digests.
tile_count.decision: Reject every smaller tile. The accepted two-tile layout is the clear local optimum among screened tile counts.

direct_source_staging_inside_32768_tile.method: Three ABBA-style counter-ordered rounds, six process medians per implementation, matching workload digests.
direct_source_staging_inside_32768_tile.decision: Reject as neutral/slightly slower. Retain the established copy-first source policy.

already_sorted_overlap_ranges.candidate: Detect already address-sorted input/output ranges before std::sort while preserving the public overlap contract and fallback sort.
already_sorted_overlap_ranges.method: Three counter-ordered ABBA process rounds per cell, six process medians per implementation, matching workload digests.
already_sorted_overlap_ranges.decision: Reject and revert. A 0.25 percent directional target improvement is far below the 5 percent promotion threshold and cannot close the exact-main gap.

correctness.sanitizers: Not rerun because every prototype was rejected and fully reverted; no executable source change remains.
correctness.fuzzing: Not run by request. This pass prioritized exact parity/recovery digests, boundary suites, direct-algebra differential tests, and optimization attribution.

decision.conclusion: No clean local change screened in this pass closes the residual exact-main gap. The accepted two-tile AVX-512VL implementation remains the best measured production schedule.
next_materially_distinct_hypotheses: A separately qualified AVX-512VBMI packed-table or GFNI/tower-field multiplication kernel that reduces GF16 table pressure rather than merely rearranging the same nibble-table passes.

A new transform executor with a demonstrably different byte-traffic strategy; do not repeat the rejected pre-expanded range executor, broad fusion, terminal fusion, smaller tiling, or source-staging variants.
